# /ttl command reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_ttl_commands.py from pack/kubejs/server_scripts/ttl/** and docs/dev/ttl-commands.toml. Edit the toml (descriptions) or the KubeJS source (commands), then re-run the generator; do not edit this file by hand. -->

Every `/ttl` command of OCS Two Lives with what it does and what it is for: 71 commands and 317 subcommand rows. The command tree is read from the KubeJS registration source and matched the live server's `/help ttl` (67 entries) on 19/11/2026; `/ttl where` and `/locate place` came to main after that check and are not on that server yet.

- **PLAYER**: anyone can run it (permission level 0). Some only work in a given life or place.
- staff: op level 2 (`hasPermission(2)`): admin tools and fixes.
- test: op level 2 too, but only for the test bots and `tests/ingame/*.rcon` (`expect`, `test*` hooks); they print `ttl: ...` when an assertion fails.
- `<name>` is a required argument, `[x]` an optional part, `(a|b)` a choice.

## Life and rebirth

Life 1, the Spirit Corridor and the rebirth into Life 2; karma, the soul carryover, the unique-skill registry, eras and how uniques change hands.

### `/ttl wish <id>`
**PLAYER** Spirit Corridor, step 1: pick your Last Wish by id. It sets the pool your unique skill is drawn from.

### `/ttl trial`
**PLAYER** Spirit Corridor, step 2: face the Trial of the Soul instead of choosing a race straight away. Passing it lets you pick 1 of 3 uniques; without it one is drawn at random.

### `/ttl answer <word>`
**PLAYER** Answer the question of the running Trial of the Soul.

### `/ttl choose <race>`
**PLAYER** Spirit Corridor: take one of the offered races for Life 2.

### `/ttl unique <skill>`
**PLAYER** Spirit Corridor: after a passed Trial, take one of the three offered unique skills (granted through the registry).

### `/ttl menu`
**PLAYER** Reopen the menu the current Corridor step needs (wish, race, unique), for example after a relog.

### `/ttl rebirth`
**PLAYER** Start the rebirth into Life 2 once the Corridor flow is at its last step.

### `/ttl reborn <target> <race>`
staff Applies a rebirth with the given race. The ttl-portals reincarnation menu (Great Sage scene) runs it when a race is confirmed; by hand only to repair a soul.

### `/ttl status`
**PLAYER** Prints your life phase (Life 1, Corridor, Life 2) and the current Corridor step.

### `/ttl life`
**PLAYER** The Life screen: what your first life earned (karma, tier, verdict).

### `/ttl karma <target>`
staff Karma of a soul: stats, axes, score and tier (a live preview in Life 1).
- staff `set <stat> <n>`: Make a Life 1 stat exactly `n` (admin fixes, bot tests).
- test: `pick` Take the first unique option at the unique step. `sample` One activity sample as if the timer fired (active time, exploration). `act` Mark the player as having acted since the last sample. `explore <x> <z> [<n>]` Visit n squares in a row from x z (the daily cap applies). `odds <wish>` 400 trial draws from a wish's pool with the soul's tier weights; fails when the rare share is off by more than 10 points. `expect <field> <value>` Assert a karma field (tier, dark, days, bosses, offers, step, phase, ledger ...).

### `/ttl reset <target>`
staff Sends a soul back to a fresh Life 1: clears items, stages, registry holds, karma, soul, reputation, story, absorb and artificer data. With `/ttl absorb clear` the only way to give a soul its awakening claim back.

### `/ttl soul`
staff Soul carryover: the Soul Gem (issued once, kept through death) and the enchantment the soul remembers. `soul <target>` shows what the soul holds.
- staff `<target> give`: Issue a Soul Gem if the body holds none.
- staff `<target> clear`: Forget the gem flag, the remembered enchantment and the cooldown.
- test: `<target> use` The Life 2 echo (short Regeneration + Resistance), as a right-click would. `expect <target> (has|<field>)` Assert a soul field, or how many stacks of an item the body holds.

### `/ttl stash <target>`
staff The Life 1 strip: banned items kept in the soul stash and soulbound stacks kept for rebirth. Without a subcommand: what the soul holds.
- staff `sweep`: Run the banned-item sweep now (Life 1 in the Mortal dimensions).
- staff `clear`: Empty the soul stash and the kept list (a /ttl reset leaves them).
- test: `equip <item>` Put one item into the first free Curios slot. `soulbound <item>` Treat that item id as soulbound until the next script reload. `spell <school> <refused>` Assert whether a cast of an Iron's Spells school is refused where the player stands. `expect <field> <n>` Assert a stash field.

### `/ttl racelock <target>`
staff The Human lock of Life 1 (a Life 1 soul with another race is set back to Human within 5 s). Without a subcommand: the soul's race and whether the lock applies.
- test: `enforce` Run the lock now. `expect <race>` Assert the race id.

### `/ttl grant <target> <skill>`
staff Grant a unique skill to a soul through the registry (caps and the Legendary ceiling apply).

### `/ttl reconcile <target>`
staff Match the registry to the uniques a soul really holds (it also runs every 5 minutes).

### `/ttl registry`
staff The unique-skill registry: who holds which unique, caps, the Legendary ceiling, the transfer log. Every grant and revoke goes through it.
- staff `slots`: Legendary slots used and free in the current era.
- staff `free <skill>`: Release a unique whose holder is gone.
- staff `history [<skill>]`: The newest 20 transfers (grants, revokes, returns to the pool), for one skill or all.
- staff `sweep`: Return to the pool now every unique of a holder inactive for skills.toml [registry] inactive_days.
- staff `migrate`: Convert name-keyed records to UUID-keyed ones.
- staff `transfer <from> <to> <skill> [<route>]`: Move a unique from one holder to another by route (duel, war, bequest, awakening, staff; default staff).
- staff `legend <target> <skill>`: Grant a Legendary that uses a per-era slot, as a rebirth Legend pick does.
- test: `legendcap (reset|<max>)` Replace max_holders and slots_per_era for a test; `reset` puts them back. `seen <target> <days>` Pretend a soul was last seen `days` days ago. `legacy <target>` Write a name-keyed legacy record for the migrate test. `expect (count|holds|has|keyed|last|pending|rarity|holders|routed|moved)` Assert counts, holders, rarity, the last transfer or pending returns.

### `/ttl era`
**PLAYER** The current era and the Legendary slots left. An era is a server-wide season; Legendary slots are counted per era.
- staff `next [silent]`: Start the next era (archives and clears the era titles; `silent` posts nothing).
- staff `set <n> [silent]`: Set the era number.
- staff `reset`: Back to era 1: clears the Legendary slot ledger, era titles and archive.
- staff `title <target> <id>`: Give a soul an era title.
- test: `testmark` Save the era state. `testrestore` Put the saved era state back, silently. `expect (number|slots|free|titles)` Assert era number, slots used or free, or a soul's title count.

### `/ttl core`
**PLAYER** Skill Cores (dropped by bosses).
- **PLAYER** `open [<target>]`: Open a Skill Core from your inventory (Life 2 only). Staff can add a player name to open one for them without an item.
- test: `odds <target>` 300 draws from the Skill Core pool with the soul's weights; prints how many were Legendary, Rare, Common or none. `expect <target> <n>` Assert how many uniques the registry lists for a soul.

### `/ttl absorb`
**PLAYER** How a unique changes hands between souls in Life 2: duel, bequest, awakening, challenge and war. Every route is a knob in skills.toml [absorb].
- **PLAYER** `status`: Your absorb cooldown, open pacts and the awakenings you have used.
- **PLAYER** `duel <target>`: Offer a consensual duel anywhere in Life 2. The loser's Legendary goes to the winner, Rare and Common are copied.
- **PLAYER** `accept <name>`: Accept a pending duel or bequest from a soul.
- **PLAYER** `decline <name>`: Refuse a pending duel or bequest.
- **PLAYER** `bequest <target> <skill>`: Hand one of your uniques on voluntarily (the other soul must accept).
- **PLAYER** `free`: A True Demon Lord or True Hero lists the free Legendaries it may claim.
- **PLAYER** `claim <skill>`: A True Demon Lord or True Hero claims a free Legendary (once per soul).
- **PLAYER** `challenge <target>`: A True Demon Lord or True Hero challenges a weaker Legendary holder; the holder cannot refuse.
- staff `simulate <killer> <victim> [<route>]`: Run a kill between two souls through the absorb rules (optionally by a route) to see the result.
- staff `war (clear|<a>)`: Flag two souls as being at war (their Legendary changes hands on a kill); `clear` drops all flags.
- staff `clear <target>`: Forget one soul's absorb state, including its awakening claim.
- test: `ep <target> <n>` Fake a soul's EP for the absorb gate. `awake <target> <kind> <state>` Fake an awakening kind and state on a soul. `testwipe <target>` Wipe a soul's local absorb data for a test. `expect (pacts|wars|<target>)` Assert open pacts, war flags, or a soul's cooldown, options, awakenings and combat state.

### `/ttl liability`
staff Duel damage liability: whoever starts a duel in a public place pays for the blocks that get broken there. These are the staff and test tools.
- staff `where <target>`: Where a player stands: which public place, and who is paid, or the wild.
- staff `sweep`: Settle finished or expired duels now.
- staff `clear`: Drop every damage record.
- test: `testbreak <target>` The player breaks the block two above their head through the normal break path. `expect (changes|liable|arena|public|above)` Assert recorded changes, liability, arena or public place of a player, or the block above them.

## Story and quests

The story core (Oath, acts), the story cast, the quest book and the side jobs of the adventurers.

### `/ttl story`
**PLAYER** The story core: your Oath path (light or dark), acts and marks (plain `/ttl story` shows them). Logic in story/story.js, the words in design/data/story.toml.
- staff `status <target>`: Your own path, acts and marks come from plain `/ttl story`; this shows the same lines for another player.
- **PLAYER** `oath [<path> [<target>]]`: Open the Oath choice, or swear it directly (light, dark, unaligned); a party leader's Oath binds the party. Staff can swear for a player.
- **PLAYER** `talk <npc>`: What a story NPC says to you now (what NPC dialog buttons run).
- **PLAYER** `fight <boss> [<target>]`: Start a boss fight from the story when you stand near its arena. Staff can start it for a player from anywhere.
- **PLAYER** `flip`: Atonement or Corruption, once per soul, after a quest has opened it.
- **PLAYER** `capstone`: Retry your personal Act VII after your team finished the book.
- staff `act <target> <n>`: Complete act n for a soul (the quest command reward `ttl story act @p 2`).
- staff `flag <target> <flag>`: Set a story flag on a soul.
- staff `unflag <target> <flag>`: Remove a story flag.
- staff `set <target> <path>`: Set the path exactly (light, dark, none) without any deltas.
- staff `reset <target>`: Forget all story state of a soul.
- test: `killrep <target> <boss>` Apply a boss's kill cost (kill_rep in bosses.toml) as a real finish would. `testunlock (mark|restore|drop)` Mark and restore the server-wide unlocked-boss list around a test that completes acts. `expect <target> <field> <a> [<b>]` Assert path, scoreboard, stage, act, flag, flips, unlocked boss, title or which NPC dialog answers.

### `/ttl cast`
staff The story cast in the world: statues of mod characters and NPCs that answer a right-click with the story talk lines.
- staff `list`: Every cast spot and its state.
- staff `load`: Force-load the chunk of every placed spot (a chunk only loaded by a teleported bot does not tick its entities).
- staff `unload`: Remove those chunk tickets again.
- test: `verify <spot>` Check one spot or all (a spot whose build is not placed is skipped). `interact <target> <what> <talk>` Do what a right-click on a spot's entity does, as a player, and check the story id. `expect <field> <value>` Assert a cast field.

### `/ttl quests`
staff The FTB Quests book and the Life 1 milestone whispers.
- staff `check`: Check that every chapter and quest of generated/quests.js (tools/gen_quests.py) is loaded by FTB Quests.
- staff `tick <target>`: Run the Life 1 milestone check of a soul now (whispers, primer book).
- test: `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert a milestone whisper was said this life, or that the primer book was given.

### `/ttl sidequest`
**PLAYER** Side jobs from the adventurers of the canon continent: fetch, escort, cull and parcel jobs.
- **PLAYER** `status [<target>]`: Your active side jobs.
- **PLAYER** `offers`: The jobs offered where you stand (the adventurers' work button).
- **PLAYER** `take <id>`: Take a job; its giver place must be within settings.take_radius.
- **PLAYER** `abandon <key>`: Drop a job (an escort client walks off, a parcel is taken back).
- **PLAYER** `turnin`: Hand in fetch jobs that have no hand-in place.
- staff `start <target> <id>`: Start a job without the giver check (FTB quest reward `ttl sidequest start {p} <id>`).
- staff `reset <target>`: Forget a player's side record and stages.
- staff `where <place>`: Where a place resolves to now.
- test: `complete <target> <key>` Force a job to complete. `fail <target> <key>` Force a job to fail. `poll [<target>]` Run the job poll now for one soul or all. `goto <target> <place>` Stand a player at a place. `bring <target>` Bring the player's escort clients beside them. `expect <target> <field> <a> [<b>]` Assert jobs, places, parcels, clients, progress or whether a start would be refused.

### `/ttl adventurers`
staff The ambient adventurers (Easy NPCs) in guild halls, plazas and road camps of the continent, who give side jobs.
- staff `list`: Places and their adventurers.
- staff `populate [<place>]`: Fill one place (or all) up to its cap now.
- staff `sweep`: Remove adventurers of an old rev or an unknown place and extras over the cap.
- staff `clear [<place>]`: Remove the adventurers of one place or all.
- test: `hold <seconds>` Stop the ambient loop from spawning for `seconds` (0 releases). `expect <place> <field> <value>` Assert how many adventurers a place has.

## World and map

The World Chronicle, faction domains, world events and the places that define where souls arrive.

### `/ttl world`
**PLAYER** The World Chronicle: era, balance and tide, growth phases of places, milestones and thrones. Numbers in design/data/world.toml.
- **PLAYER** `where`: Whether you stand on the canon continent (story rules apply) or outside it.
- staff `at <x> <z>`: The same for an overworld column x z.
- staff `log [<n>]`: The last n chronicle entries.
- staff `balance add <n>`: Move the light/dark balance by n (-100..100); the tide follows.
- staff `milestone (list|fire)`: List milestones, or fire one (its effects run, it stays reached).
- staff `phase set <place> <phase>`: Set a place's growth phase.
- staff `conflict (open|close)`: Open or close the takeover path of a canon nation.
- staff `rule (set|clear)`: Set or clear who sits on a canon throne (faction, nation, mode).
- staff `active (set|clear)`: Set or clear a timed world state such as rebuilding.
- staff `recount`: Backfill every online soul, recount from the ledger and evaluate.
- staff `sync <target>`: Rewrite a soul's world mirrors (what login does).
- staff `forget <target>`: Remove a soul's ttl.world stages and heard Voice lines.
- staff `export`: One JSON line of the chronicle (Discord, BlueMap, Hall).
- test: `testmark` Save the world and start a blank one in which test bots count. `testrestore` Put the saved world back. `testthreshold (reset|<souls>)` Replace the milestone threshold until testrestore; `reset` undoes it. `expect <what>` Assert continent, milestone, phase, tide, balance, unlocked event, mood, conflict, rule, first boss or a dotted path.

### `/ttl domain`
**PLAYER** Faction domains on the continent (Tempest and others): who may change blocks where.
- staff `check <x> <z>`: Inside or outside the continent, the domain at x z and who may edit there.
- staff `list`: Every domain part in force (placed builds and landmarks).
- staff `residents`: Tempest's residents and their last state.
- staff `respawn`: Run the resident check now.
- test: `testdelay (reset|<seconds>)` Set the respawn delay of killable residents in seconds; `reset` undoes it. `testbreak <player> <x> <z> (kept|broken)` Put stone on the surface at x z and let the player break it through the game's own path; fails when the outcome is not kept or broken as expected. `testdoor <player> <x> <z> (opens|shut)` Put a door on the surface and let the player right-click it. `expect <what>` Assert who may edit, the faction at x z, a resident's state, invulnerability or part counts.

### `/ttl npcgear`
staff Weapons and fighting behaviour of the generic NPCs (design/data/npc_gear.toml): Tempest's guards and the Easy NPC adventurers.
- staff `refresh`: Re-equip every Tempest resident with its role's items now.
- staff `guards`: Run the guard pass now: how many guards stand near their posts and how many were set on a monster.
- test: `testspawn <kind> <pos>` Import an adventurer's preset at a position, tagged as a test NPC. `testclear` Remove the test NPCs. `expect <what>` Assert a resident's or test NPC's main or offhand item, or that nothing with a tag is alive.

### `/ttl events`
staff The event director: world events with a schedule, and the chat lines players get for them. Only `mute` is for players.
- staff `next`: The schedule only.
- **PLAYER** `mute`: Toggle the chat lines (and Great Sage clips) of world events for yourself; titles stay.
- staff `fire <id> [force]`: Start an event now (not counted in the daily cap); `force` restarts an active one.
- staff `end [<id>]`: End one event, or all of them.
- staff `reschedule <id>`: Forget the stored next start and compute it again from events.toml.
- test: `due <id>` Make an event due now. `tick [<id>]` Run one scheduler pass now (with an id: only that event, test bots count as online). `setup <target> <ep> <hours>` A Life 2 player with this EP and this many hours played this week. `offerset <target> <ids>` Give a player exactly this Favor offer. `clear <target>` Forget a player's Favor offer, cooldown and play week. `expect <field> <a> [<b>]` Assert active events, schedule, registration, a captured gamerule, the Favor winner or a player's offer, cooldown, unique or mute.

### `/ttl favor`
**PLAYER** The World's Favor: a blessing offered to you by a world event.
- **PLAYER** `choose <id>`: Take one of the offered blessings by id.

### `/ttl where [<id>]`
**PLAYER** Which way a known place lies: a compass direction and a rounded distance, never coordinates or a teleport hint (Tensura world only). Without an id: the places you know.

### `/locate place <id>`
staff Extends vanilla `/locate`: where a canon place (anchor, settlement, build or landmark) stands, with coordinates, the distance and a click-to-suggest teleport; a planned spot is marked as not placed yet. Tab-complete lists the ids. The player version is `/ttl where`.

### `/ttl tempest`
staff Test hooks for early Tempest (the goblin village placed by life/tempest.js).
- test: `expect (passes|crops)` Assert that Tempest was placed at the current version with n slab passes, or that at least n crops stand in its field.

### `/ttl arrival`
staff The Life 2 arrival point on the safe rim of the Jura forest, and the world spawn.
- test: `expect <target> (near|alive)` Assert that a bot stands within `blocks` of the arrival point, or is alive.

### `/ttl spiritdomain`
staff The Dwelling of the Spirits: a gate in the Great Jura Forest into its own dimension (ttl:spirit_domain). Not the Spirit Corridor.
- staff `where`: Where the spirit gate and the Dwelling are placed.
- staff `tp <target>`: Send a player into the Dwelling (needs the Dwelling placed and a fitting life phase).
- test: `walk <target> (gate|back)` Walk a player through the gate or back. `expect <target> (in|out)` Assert that a player is in or out of the Dwelling.

### `/ttl worldreset <ids>`
staff Run by ttl-portals after it regenerated dimensions (comma-separated ids): places Wayfarer's Rest and the Tensura world spawn again and moves players with an old position to the new spawn. Not for typing by hand.

## Builds and landmarks

Canon builds and landmarks, the chunk tickets the placers use and the Mortal Realm's spawn.

### `/ttl build`
staff Canon builds (design/builds/*.toml, blueprints/*.py): the placer puts each one on its canon spot once per version.
- staff `<name>`: Place the blueprint `name` with its corner at your feet (a build tool, not the canon placer).
- staff `list`: Every build and whether it is placed.
- staff `where <name>`: Where a build was placed (corner, anchor, version).
- staff `place <name> [force]`: Place a build, or all; `force` places it again even when the version is current.
- test: `expect <name> (placed|repaired|cell)` Assert that a build is placed, how much the terrain repair filled, or the block at a cell.

### `/ttl landmark`
staff Canon landmarks (design/data/landmarks.toml) placed with Tensura's own jigsaw structures: Rigurd's goblin village, the Lake Siss lizardmen, the orc camp.
- staff `list`: Every landmark and its state.
- staff `place <name>`: Place a landmark, or all.
- staff `where <name>`: Where a landmark was placed.

### `/ttl works`
staff One-time world works on Lerfing's map: the planted forests (Tempest, Treyni) and the trade roads (the Dwarven Road), placed once after the builds.
- staff `list`: Every forest and road with its state (planted / laid, or the piece it resumes at).
- staff `run <kind> <id> [force]`: Queue a forest or road (`<kind> <id>`); with force, again over what is there.
- staff `where road <id> <arc>`: Position and tp command of a road at an arc length.
- test: `expect (forest|road)` Assert a forest planted (at least n giants), a road laid, or the road surface at an arc length.

### `/ttl chunks`
staff The chunk tickets the placers use to load a rectangle without a synchronous forceload.
- test: `hold <x0> <z0> <x1> <z1>` Hold an overworld rectangle x0 z0 x1 z1. `expect loaded <x> <z>` Assert that a chunk is FULL right now.

### `/ttl spawn`
staff Where Life 1 starts: Wayfarer's Rest in the Mortal Realm, and its version.

### `/ttl wayfarer`
staff Test hook for the Wayfarer's Rest build protection.
- test: `expect <player> <x> <dy> <z> (protected|open)` Assert that a block at the player's x, y+dy, z is protected or open for them.

## Bosses and arenas

The boss framework and the PvP and party arenas, including the Walpurgis Hall.

### `/ttl boss`
staff The boss framework (bosses/boss.js, design/data/bosses.toml): summon, watch and clean up bosses.
- staff `summon <id> [<x> <y> <z>]`: Summon a boss at x y z, else at its arena, else where you stand. Skips the cooldown and requires.
- staff `list`: Every boss: tier, fixed spawn, wild chance, state while one is out.
- staff `wild [roll <id> [<target>]]`: The wild roll: knobs, today's starts, what roams; `roll <id> [player]` starts a wild boss near a player now.
- staff `abort [<id>]`: Remove a summoned boss (or all) without rewards; a freed arena goes to the head of its queue.
- staff `reset <target>`: Forget a player's boss stages, kill counts and cooldown stamps.
- staff `cooldown clear <id>`: `clear <id|all>`: forget the per-party cooldown stamps and arena gaps of a boss.
- staff `arena clear <id>`: `clear <id|all>`: forget a boss's arena gaps and queue.
- staff `queue [clear|<id>]`: Who waits for which boss arena; `clear [id]` empties it.
- test: `testparty (set|clear)` Make these players one party for boss credit (`set a b [c]`, `clear`). `testecho (set|clear)` Make a boss count as already fallen, so its fights are echoes (`set <id>`, `clear`). `expect <target> <field> <a> <b>` Assert a boss field for a player (stage, defeated, kills, active, cooldown, queue, gate, wild chance, cores ...).

### `/ttl arena`
**PLAYER** PvP and party arenas (arena/arenas.js, design/data/arenas.toml).
- **PLAYER** `list`: The arenas and their state.
- **PLAYER** `join <arena> [<mode> [<side>]]`: Join an arena as a duel, party or challenge fighter (modes duel, party, challenge; sides a or b).
- **PLAYER** `leave`: Leave your arena and go back where you came from.
- **PLAYER** `start [<arena>]`: Start the match you joined. Staff can start an arena by name.
- staff `reset [<arena>]`: Reset one arena or all.
- staff `clear <target>`: Clear a player's arena state.
- staff `defeat <target> [<by>]`: Count a player as defeated (optionally by someone).
- staff `wave <arena> clear`: Clear the current wave of an arena.
- staff `end <arena> <how>`: End a match: a, b, draw, clear, partial or fail.
- test: `testat <arena> (clear|<x>)` Place an arena at x y z for a test, or `clear` it. `testmode <state>` Switch the arena test mode on or off. `expect (arena|player)` Assert an arena's state, mode, phase, result, players or wave, or a player's record and cooldowns.

### `/ttl walpurgis`
**PLAYER** The Walpurgis Hall: the Demon Lords' council chamber and the Banquet Floor arena in the dimension ttl:walpurgis. Entry by invitation or condition (a Legendary, a story capstone or a booked match).
- **PLAYER** `status`: Whether you may enter and why not.
- **PLAYER** `go`: Enter the hall when you qualify (only while command_entry is on in arenas.toml; otherwise through the dais of Clayman's throne).
- **PLAYER** `invite <target> [<hours>]`: Invite a soul for some hours (Legendary holders may, when invite_by_legendary; staff always).
- staff `uninvite <target>`: Cancel an invitation.
- staff `where`: Where the Walpurgis Hall and its gate are placed.
- staff `tp <target>`: Send a player into the hall; refused when they do not qualify.
- test: `walk <target> (gate|back)` Walk a player through the doorway or back. `expect <target> (in|out|allowed)` Assert that a player is in or out of the hall, or allowed to enter.

## Nations and economy

Nations, the coin economy, merit and reputation.

### `/ttl nation`
**PLAYER** Nations: an FTB party that its owner founds (create and fill the party with /ftbteams first). Logic in nations/nations.js, claims in nations/claims.js.
- **PLAYER** `info [<name>]`: Your nation, or any nation by name: rank, value, members, land, treasury, allies, wars.
- **PLAYER** `found <name>`: Found the nation of your party: the party owner, Life 2, in the overworld, with the boss stage and the charter fee.
- **PLAYER** `dissolve`: The owner ends the nation (the treasury is paid back; the party stays).
- **PLAYER** `top`: All nations by value.
- **PLAYER** `value`: What you are worth (renown) and what your nation is worth.
- **PLAYER** `deposit <coin> <n>`: Pay coins (bronze, silver, gold, stellar) into the treasury.
- **PLAYER** `withdraw <coin> <n>`: The owner takes coins out of the treasury.
- **PLAYER** `ally <name>`: Offer an alliance (mutual once the other owner does the same).
- **PLAYER** `unally <name>`: End an alliance.
- **PLAYER** `war <name>`: Declare war on a nation (counts after diplomacy.war_notice_hours).
- **PLAYER** `peace <name>`: End a war.
- staff `sync`: Reconcile nations with FTB Teams now (stages, claim allowance, disbanded parties).
- test: `test <target> <what>` Test hooks: Life 2 stage, charter stage, leave party, drop the record, make wars active, run upkeep, clear extra claims. `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert a nation field or try a real action (found, war, withdraw) and read what refused it.

### `/ttl econ`
staff The coin economy (bronze is the base unit): this week's faucet and sink counters and the last weeks.
- staff `give <target> <n>`: Pay a soul bronze from nowhere (counts as a staff faucet).
- staff `take <target> <n>`: Take bronze from a soul.
- test: `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert a balance, faucet, sink, fee or whether a soul can pay.

### `/ttl merit`
**PLAYER** Your merit from building and the Public Works chunks you keep (Life 2).
- **PLAYER** `works (mark|unmark)`: `mark` or `unmark` the chunk you stand in as Public Works (Life 2, Tensura overworld).
- staff `reset <target>`: Forget a player's merit.
- test: `test <target> <block> [<n>]` Count n placed blocks of a type at a player's feet. `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert merit total, week, works or the builder title.

### `/ttl rep`
**PLAYER** Reputation with the factions (-100..100, bands from hostile to exalted) and renown. Logic in rep/rep.js.
- staff `list <target>`: The same standing list for someone else.
- **PLAYER** `renown [<target>]`: Your renown (your worth) with its parts. Staff can look at a player.
- staff `set <target> <faction> <n>`: Set a faction value exactly.
- staff `add <target> <faction> <n>`: Change a faction value by n (what NPC dialog actions run).
- staff `bonus <target> <n>`: Permanent bonus renown (quests, merit, staff); negative lowers it.
- staff `log [<n>]`: The newest n reputation changes.
- test: `seed <target> [<race>]` Redo the rebirth seeding from race and stored karma. `decay <target> <weeks>` Apply that many weekly decay steps now. `expect <target> <faction> <field> <value>` Assert a faction band, value, stage or scoreboard mirror, or a renown part.

## Paths (necro, artifice, roads, choices)

The player paths: Necromancer, Artificer, the two roads and the moral-choice scenes.

### `/ttl necro`
**PLAYER** The Necromancer path: rank, the Church's eye (Sense, Holy Hunt, licence) and the legion of the dead. Logic in necro/necro.js, necro/legion.js, necro/sanctum.js.
- **PLAYER** `status`: Who you are among the dead: rank, points, the Church's eye, licence.
- **PLAYER** `rank`: The rank ladder.
- **PLAYER** `rite [<pay>]`: Become a necromancer at your Bone Altar (a rite spell plus the reagent, ash or dust).
- **PLAYER** `licence`: Ask the Church for a licence (Honored, 14 clean days, in its lands).
- **PLAYER** `license`: The same as `licence`.
- **PLAYER** `bounties`: The Church's bounty list (Marked souls).
- **PLAYER** `raise <kind> [<road> [<label>]]`: Raise a skeleton or zombie at your Bone Altar (dust = grey, ash = dark), with an optional label.
- **PLAYER** `knight <name> [<road>]`: Make a Death Knight (rank 3+, the gear, 32 dust or ash and a corpse).
- **PLAYER** `stow [<which>]`: Put your dead near you to sleep in the tomb.
- **PLAYER** `rouse [<which>]`: Wake sleeping dead at the altar.
- **PLAYER** `recall`: Your loaded dead within 64 blocks come to you.
- **PLAYER** `stand <which> <mode>`: Turn your dead into tomb guards (no AI) or back to life.
- **PLAYER** `rest`: Lay the dead under a grave marker to rest (the Keeper).
- **PLAYER** `muster`: Count your army; a nation at war holds the war cap for 24 h.
- **PLAYER** `sanctum`: What your tomb is and what it needs to grow.
- **PLAYER** `legion [info|altar|sanctum|corpse|pvp|sweep|test|expect]`: Your legion. Staff have more subcommands (info, altar, sanctum, corpse, pvp, sweep, test, expect).
- staff `info <target>`: The necro record of a soul.
- staff `points <target> <how> <n>`: Add to or set rank points (add goes through the weekly cap).
- staff `sense <target> <how> <n>`: Add to or set the Church's Sense; marks and the Hunt follow.
- staff `hunt <target> <how>`: Start or end the Holy Hunt on a soul.
- test: `test <target> <what> [<n>]` Test hooks: clean days, licence place rule, continent, hunt minutes, week, refresh, reset. `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert a necro field (rank, points, entry, sense, marked, hunted, licence, bounty ...).

### `/ttl artifice`
**PLAYER** The Artificer path: Workshop Benches, schematics, commissions and engraving. Logic in artifice/*.js, data in design/data/artifice.toml.
- **PLAYER** `status`: Rank, points, caps and what is next.
- **PLAYER** `charter`: Sign the charter at a Workshop Bench (3 schematics known or carried).
- **PLAYER** `commissions`: Today's commission board.
- **PLAYER** `commission (take|turnin|abandon|test)`: `take <n|id>`, `turnin` or `abandon <n|id>` a commission. Staff: `test <player> <id>` accepts one that is not on the board.
- **PLAYER** `engrave [<engraving>]`: List engravings, or engrave the item in your main hand (rank 2+, chisel, own work).
- **PLAYER** `make [<recipe>]`: List the workshop recipes, or make one.
- **PLAYER** `curse`: Put a cursed whetstone on the blade in your main hand (dark road).
- **PLAYER** `schematic buy`: `buy`: buy a Dwargon schematic for coin (honest road).
- **PLAYER** `steal`: Steal a schematic from the Dwargon smithy at night (dark road).
- staff `info <target>`: The artificer record of a soul.
- staff `firsts`: The server's first maker of each metal.
- staff `roll`: Roll a new commission board.
- staff `refresh <target>`: Re-sync a soul's artificer stages and scoreboard.
- staff `points <target> (add|set)`: Add to or set artificer points.
- test: `test <target> (craft|kiln|<what>)` Test hooks: Life 1/2, reset, relaxed or strict theft rules, bench and kiln code paths, stamp the main-hand item. `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert an artificer field (rank, points, jobs, metals, stamp, cursed, enchantments, try_* answers ...).

### `/ttl roads`
**PLAYER** The two roads: routes you took in moral choices (counts per choice, never the karma numbers). Logic in roads/roads.js, data in design/data/roads.toml.
- staff `list`: Every choice and its routes.
- staff `info <target>`: A soul's counts, firsts, today's balance notes, ledger and last result.
- staff `witnesses <target>`: Who would witness an act where the player stands.
- staff `pay <target> <system> <act> <road> [<faction>]`: Take a route for a soul and pay its costs.
- staff `log [<n>]`: The newest n routes taken.
- test: `items [<target>]` Check that every path item and block is registered, or give a player one of each. `block <pos> <id>` Assert the block at a position. `test <target> <what>` Life 2 or Life 1 stage only, or forget roads state and ledger. `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert a ledger value, route count, first-time flag, tide notes or the last result.

### `/ttl paths`
**PLAYER** The paths you can walk (necromancer, artificer ...): the guide page plus a short list in chat.

### `/ttl choice`
**PLAYER** Moral-choice scenes in the world (hostages, a sick village, a starving horde ...). Engine in choices/engine.js, data in design/data/choices.toml.
- **PLAYER** `take <sid> <route>`: Take a menu route of a scene (what the clickable buttons run).
- staff `list`: Open scenes, registered events and their weights.
- staff `spawn <event> [near|<pos>]`: Spawn a scene at a position, or `near <player>` where a natural roll would put it.
- staff `roll [<target>]`: A natural roll now (no chance, no gap; the caps apply).
- staff `resolve <sid> <route> [<target>]`: Resolve a scene as if a player completed a route, or end it the neutral way.
- staff `clear`: End and clear every scene now (no costs, no chronicle).
- test: `act <target> <sid> <route>` Take a menu route as another player (bots). `test <target> (skill|<verb>)` Scene test verbs (heal, free, feed, kill, owner ...) and fake skills for a soul. `testonline <n>` Fake the number of Life 2 souls online for the scale. `reset <target>` Forget a soul's choice history, dark cap and test skills. `expect (scene|player|world)` Assert a scene, player or world field.

## Social (party, companion, guild)

Parties, companions, the Free Guild, the guide and the leaderboard.

### `/ttl party`
**PLAYER** Your party (an FTB Teams party): leader, members, the party's Oath and boss credit. Create, invite, join, leave and kick are FTB's own `/ftbteams party ...`.
- staff `status <target>`: The same lines for another player.
- staff `poll`: Run one path-lock pass now (it also runs every 3 seconds).
- test: `expect <target> <field> <a> [<b>]` Assert party membership, size, owner, path, cap or boss roster.

### `/ttl companion`
**PLAYER** Companions: an adventurer you hire for coins who follows and fights for you.
- **PLAYER** `status`: Your companion.
- **PLAYER** `hire`: Hire the nearest hireable adventurer within 6 blocks (Life 2; limits and the party cap apply).
- **PLAYER** `dismiss`: Send your companion away.
- test: `grant <target> <kind> [<minutes>]` Give a player a companion of a kind for some minutes. `clear <target>` Remove a player's companion. `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert companion count, kind, alive or can_hire.

### `/ttl guild`
**PLAYER** The Free Guild (Life 2): a bounty board with daily and weekly bounties, handed out by desks and the guild master Fuze.
- **PLAYER** `board [<giver>]`: The board with your status per bounty (optionally one giver: desk or fuze).
- **PLAYER** `take <ref> [<giver>]`: Accept a bounty by slot or id.
- **PLAYER** `turnin [<giver>]`: Hand in everything that is ready.
- **PLAYER** `abandon <ref>`: Drop an accepted bounty.
- **PLAYER** `status`: Your guild points, rank and bounties (Life 2 only).
- staff `roll [<which>]`: Re-roll the board now (daily, weekly or all).
- staff `desk (add|remove|list)`: `add x y z`, `remove x y z` or `list` the interim guild desks.
- staff `npc (list|ensure|spawn|remove|goto|expect)`: The guild's Easy NPCs: `list`, `ensure`, `spawn`, `remove`, `goto`, `expect`.
- test: `post <id>` Put a bounty into the first slot of its period. `sample <target>` Sample kills and visits now instead of waiting. `test <target> <what>` Give a bot the Life 2 stage. `reset <target>` Forget a player's guild record. `expect <target> <field> <value>` Assert a guild field (points, rank, board slots, accepted/ready bounty, take answers ...).

### `/ttl guide [<set>]`
**PLAYER** The guide pop-up (Great Sage style screen). Without an argument the main guide; also `corridor`, `life2` and other page sets.

### `/ttl talk`
**PLAYER** What the Voice of the World NPC runs on right-click.

### `/ttl top`
**PLAYER** The leaderboard in chat (the same standings as #leaderboard in Discord).

## Ops and testing

Debug, Discord and test tooling for staff and the test bots.

### `/ttl inspect <target>`
staff One line with a soul's state: phase, dimension, position, Corridor step, wish, offers, race, uniques, trial result and karma. Answers over RCON, so the tests can read it.

### `/ttl as <target> <command>`
test bot Run a command as the player typed it (for example FTB party commands for test bots). Prints the result; a refusal is not an error.

### `/ttl ops`
test bot The command log of /ttl and the other ops commands (literal paths only, never free text, selectors or NBT).
- test: `expect cmdlog last <path>` Assert the last logged command path: `expect cmdlog last <path>`.

### `/ttl guideforget <target>`
staff Show the once-only guide pop-ups to a player again.

### `/ttl npc`
staff Where the Voice of the World NPC in the Spirit Corridor is (fails when it is missing).
- staff `respawn`: Replace the NPC, then report where it is.

### `/ttl discord`
staff Discord posting of story events.
- test: `mute [on|off|status]` `on`, `off` or `status`: drop every Discord post. tools/server.sh sets it around each test run. `expect <target> <moment> <count>` Assert how many story lines a bot's session would have posted for a moment, without contacting Discord.

### `/ttl discordroles <target>`
staff Compute and sync the Life and karma roles of a linked player on Discord.
- staff `dry [expect nation]`: Print the computed roles without contacting Discord (without it the roles are synced now).
- test: `expect <keys>` Assert the computed role keys.

### `/ttl staff`
staff Read-only overviews, also available as Discord `?ttl staff ...` commands for the modder role.
- staff `status`: Who is online: life phase, title and dimension per player (test bots left out).
- staff `registry`: Held uniques and their holders.

### `/ttl recap`
staff The weekly Hall of Souls recap (Sunday 20:00, posted to #story).
- staff `preview`: Print the recap without posting.
- staff `now`: Post the recap now.
